royalhotel_host.text: Welcome to the Royal Hotel. We have sat by the harbour a long time and the view has only improved.
Portree is Port Rìgh in Gaelic, often said to mean the King's Harbour, after King James V landed here in 1540 to calm the island chiefs.
In 1746 Flora MacDonald said goodbye to Bonnie Prince Charlie in Portree, after helping him escape disguised as her maid, Betty Burke.
